Fetched every pinned revision (Commons Lang 5904c573, 3e50a7f9 and 3.14.0, Commons IO 2.19.0, Text 1.12.0, Collections 4.5.0, the Gson #719 and Guava #7955 pairs, Spring 6.2.0, CBMC 6.11.0 and d2972052 regression folders, jdk21u 21.0.13) into bare mirrors with worktrees under ~/.cache/in-the-loop/jbmc-java-semantics-gap; resolved and signature-checked the released Commons, Spring and Guava 33.4.8/33.5.0 jars; built Commons Lang 3e50a7f9 and both Gson sides; fetched and verified Temurin 24.0.2 for Guava's toolchain; found that the brief's preflight JBMC and models are the CBMC 6.11.0 Ubuntu 22.04 package, not the installed 24.04 one, and that the models jar alone flips ExtraOpeners.firstDeclared.

commits.summary: Record the semantics-gap setup's JBMC rerun and resubmit the Guava #7955 build (verification pending)
commits.body:
The stock JBMC 6.11.0 rerun (job 20261123-075049-setup-rerun-the-brief-s-stock-jbmc-6-11) passed: with the brief's preflight binary and models (the Ubuntu 22.04 package) all 14 seed entries give the brief's results and all 11 CORE upstream regression files pass; the installed 24.04 models flip both of #6's entries (dispatch FAILURE, firstDeclared SUCCESS), and the 22.04 models under the installed binary restore them, so the models jar alone decides #6. The two KNOWNBUG files behave as marked, test_sync_static with the static-synchronized warning the brief cites. The setup record and its Setup Agent Notes now say so.

The Guava #7955 build (job 20261123-075049-setup-build-guava-at-the-7955-parent-and) failed after 36 s: Maven's test phase cannot give guava-testlib the module com.google.common, because guava's module-info.class is only in META-INF/versions/9 and is found only in the packaged jar. The job script now runs verify (javadoc and sources skipped), as upstream CI does, without installing anything, and the job is resubmitted as 20261123-081114-setup-build-guava-at-the-7955-parent-and. Setup only: no claims, examples or library changes.

commits.summary: Resubmit the semantics-gap setup's Guava #7955 build with the classpath print online (verification pending)
commits.body:
The second Guava job (20261123-081114) built the fix side of #7955, passed StringsTest (21 tests, 0 failures) and packaged its jar, then failed printing guava's classpath: dependency:build-classpath ran offline, and Guava's pom pins maven-dependency-plugin 3.1.1, which the build never fetches. The setup script now runs that call online with --strict-checksums, checked inline on the fix tree in 5.8 s; the setup record gives the result, the new script digest and the resolved classpath.

Job 20261123-082702-setup-build-guava-at-the-7955-parent-and supersedes it and runs both sides, the fix's test on the parent, the offline rerun and the cleanup.

commits.summary: Record the semantics-gap setup's Guava #7955 build: both jars built, the regression reproduced
commits.body: Job 20261123-082702-setup-build-guava-at-the-7955-parent-and, the third attempt, passed in 3 min 11 s (peak 2.0 GiB); its results are on the results head 7ab232b4515a, which this line has not merged. At the parent 47b7e9e5 and the fix 148cea07, Guava's own StringsTest passes (21 tests each). The fix's StringsTest run against the parent's code errors in testLenientFormat with ArrayStoreException: java.lang.String. The offline rerun passes, and both worktrees were left clean. The setup record now gives both jars' sha256 (parent 3e0c1d18…, fix 1ca60c03…, the same bytes as the second attempt's, since Guava's pom fixes the output timestamp), their Strings.class digests and their shared five-jar runtime classpath. Run inline on Temurin 21.0.13 (and on 25.0.5), the Lenient probe on the built jars gives the brief's section 5 answers: on the parent, Integer[] throws ArrayStoreException with its references kept and Object[] has its cells replaced by Strings; on the fix, both return the text with their references kept. With this, setup for the brief is complete. No claims, examples or verifier runs.
